fusions.name: Bulldozing Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 7 tiles onto a target and bowls into it, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Forepaw Slam
fusions.desc: Slams both forepaws down, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%. Holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Lumbering Momentum
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds, with 6% more armour while it holds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Goaded Into a Charge
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
